nodes.name: reproduction.required

nodes.description: the finding is verified gone on the candidate by another run
nodes.name: verification.required

protocol.description: One improvement turn on takt: a finding that names a machine-checkable predicate on a scenario or on a repository at a seed is reproduced on the promoted baseline, a candidate fix is delivered and merged under the authority its surface needs, the finding is verified gone on the candidate by another run than the one that delivered it, the scorecard shows no regression against the baseline, and the candidate's binary is promoted. Accepted once promoted; declined when the candidate still reproduces the finding; unreproducible when the baseline never did. Claims about the baseline and about the candidate are about separate artifacts, so a commit to the candidate leaves the baseline's claims standing.
